name: game-level-planning
goal: Describe, generate, review and approve each 2D/3D level before building it and creating checkpoints

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Concept, level brief, LLM layout review, approval, build, then checkpoints. Legacy views remain editable. Current authoring test has no planning entry; engine and document tests omit draft gates/schema. Extend those unchanged standards before repair.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Opus 5.5 planner and controls plus bounded provider generation, approval/build gating and embedded engine support are committed at 93251b616. Focused checks passed; paired immutable green proof is being recorded.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Frozen complete corpus: 19 focused browser cases plus one optional skip; 25 catalog checks with inspected desktop/mobile screenshots; 14 backend/IPC cases; 27 game and 135 remote unit cases; 10 scaffold/template guards. Type, lint, style tokens, audits and registry checks pass. Full CLI/native execution is deferred by the user.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
steps.evidence: Paired immutable proof: red 28acfcd9f / ff6df61f fails at missing New level; green 428d6ffa9 / 3deef8ee passes with identical complete test corpus and environment, retaining 243 visible-unit captures and 1959 measurements. Final product tree equals original 75bed6fac. Focused local verification passed; full CLI/native suites remain explicitly deferred.
